Verified by byte dump and `cmp` against a freshly built expectation: **exact match**, 59 bytes, all five lines still CRLF. (`name=demo`, `debug=false`, `log=info` untouched.)

One thing worth flagging: `hashline_edit` silently re-wrote the *whole* file's line endings to LF — it stripped the CR off every line, not just mine. I caught it in the byte check and repaired the endings with a `perl` pass that converts lone `\n` back to `\r\n`, so the net diff is only the two lines you asked for. If you edit CRLF files here regularly, prefer a byte-level tool — the line-based editors in this harness normalize endings.
